summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 3.7 Flash, claiming improved agentic performance and coding accuracy, illustrated with a demo of a three-agent team autonomously training a robotics control model.

mechanisms.reason: The post describes a multi-agent team autonomously executing a delegated training task rather than a human operating software directly, but it is a single demo, not a measured industry shift.
mechanisms.quote: we set up a 3-agent team to autonomously train a robotics control model from scratch

practices.reason: A named, shipped model variant is claimed to improve on agentic and coding performance, dimensions teams would evaluate for adoption in coding/agent pipelines.
practices.quote: 3.7 Flash brings a big jump in agentic performance and coding accuracy.

practices.reason: The multi-agent demo gestures at a multi-agent orchestration pattern but gives no design details or stated gain an engineer could implement from.
practices.quote: we set up a 3-agent team to autonomously train a robotics control model from scratch
